 - 8 slots on the board, 0 drawn without channels, 0 set aside
 - the memory controller is in the chipset: no processor owns a slot, and the board draws one controller
   in the place of the CPUs
 - 8 slots placed by the table of the board family dell-pe-1950-2950, written from Dell PowerEdge 1950
   Systems Hardware Owner's Manual, P/N HH176, Rev. A02, September 2009, pp. 26, 63-65
